about: Examples for the post.json verdict adjustment rules. scan_verdict = scan verdict (default ALLOW), features = scan result values, osv_ok = OSV reachable (default true), vdiff/late = version comparison results. hit = this rule must match. Run: python3 guard/rule_check.py
